title: Nutrient-Rich No-Fuss Nibbles British Potatoes Bubble and Squeak
description: A sweet and energizing British dish featuring sumac and miso-marinate, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack. This bubble and squeak recipe is anti-inflammatory-friendly and features a crispy binchotan-grill vessel.
instructions: Peel the British potatoes and grate them coarsely.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, lemon juice, and sumac to make the marinade.
Add the grated potatoes to the marinade and mix until they're evenly coated.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the marinated potatoes to the skillet and cook for 4-6 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden.
Sprinkle chili flakes over the top, if using.
Transfer the potatoes to a plate and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Grill the potatoes using a binchotan grill for an additional 2-3 minutes, until crispy.
